children: Internet Computer's ChatGPT plugin is now available in the ChatGPT plugin directory. The plugin connects ChatGPT to Internet Computer apps, letting users read app data and make changes across more than one app from a chat.

Internet Computer apps gain a distribution channel through ChatGPT, where users can access them directly and act across apps in the same conversation. The announcement includes no direct change to ICP token mechanics.
